title.en: Can a second blind pass test the bridge between a question and a source span?
title.ru: Может ли второй слепой проход проверить связь между вопросом и фрагментом источника?

hypothesis.en: Selecting a source span by ID removes copying errors, and a separate question-to-span bridge rejects BR10-like mismatches without losing more than one useful source.
hypothesis.ru: Выбор фрагмента по ID уберёт ошибки копирования, а отдельная проверка связи вопроса с фрагментом отсеет ошибки вроде BR10, потеряв не больше одного полезного источника.

inputs.note: Same pairs as 3C.2 provide a controlled protocol comparison. This is not a held-out generalisation test.

stage_a.name: span_selector
stage_a.input: question plus one source split deterministically into numbered sentences
stage_a.allowed_result: one span ID such as S2, or NONE
stage_a.important: The harness retrieves the exact span text by ID. The model never has to copy it.

stage_b.name: blind_bridge
stage_b.input: question plus the selected span; no sender claim, label, source ID, search score, or earlier model answer

decision.selector_plus_bridge: accept only when the selected span receives HELPFUL; reject NONE, NOT_HELPFUL, UNCLEAR, and malformed output

not_tested: showing the sender claim after a miss
